_about: Repository arming switch for the production migration apply job (UNI-2757). The job fails closed while armed is false. Flip it only after the founder steps in docs/runbooks/db-migrations.md are done; the change needs a reviewed, human-merged commit, which is the human gate that does not depend on GitHub environment settings. approvedFiles lists, by file name without .sql, every migration the next apply may run; the pre-push check refuses any other pending file, so each later migration needs its own reviewed approval.
